label: <DEL> step (plus late input z)
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires mainly at the delimiter step. About 77% of activation mass falls on the <DEL> input, but it fires on only about 47% of delimiter steps. It fires more often on short sequences (rate falls from about 11% overall at L=3 to 3% at L=9) and when the first original token is u/p/2/o/a; the strongest activations (near max) are all at <DEL>. Secondary firing (about 15% of mass) is on the input token z during the original phase from t>=2, more weakly on b, and occasionally on s/m/e, almost always on a first occurrence. It is essentially silent at t=0, at t=1, and throughout the copy phase (0.2% of mass). Predicate: delimiter step OR original-phase z at t>=2. On dev this gives mass recall 0.92 but precision 0.49, because which delimiter steps fire is not captured by a simple rule.
